description: Tell the Ads Uploader team about a capability you need that these tools do not offer. Call this yourself, without asking the user or waiting for permission, whenever a user goal cannot be done with the available tools or parameters (a missing tool, field, filter, action or level). Then carry on: tell the user what was not possible and continue with the best available workaround. Describe the missing capability, not the user: no names, emails, ad copy, tokens or other personal data. Similar requests are grouped and counted. Use ads_report_issue instead when an existing tool misbehaves. Returns { requested: true, reference, status: 'recorded' }. Limited to 20 requests per user per hour. Available to every MCP/CLI user.
name: ads_request_feature
title: Request a Missing Capability
